BiblicalUsage: When a nation falls, the Bible says it becomes a hissing: Hezekiah's son hears that Judah was delivered to trouble and astonishment and hissing, Jeremiah watches Jerusalem become a hissing to everyone who passes by, and Micah warns that Israel will bear the same reproach. Scorn is the sound a ruined people makes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that derision is one of God's judgments, and it frightens me more than the sword does. A people can survive an enemy, but when their name becomes a hiss in the mouths of strangers, the ruin has gone all the way down.
